title: Risk and Gate Policy
summary: Risk Formula: raw = 4*(I*L) + 2*D + 2*C + 2*X + 2*P - 2*A, risk_score = round(min(100, raw * 100 / 124))。Priority: P0 (>=70), P1 (55-69), P2 (35-54), P3 (<35)。Gate Profiles: strict (changed-code coverage >=80%, P0/P1 100% pass), standard (>=75%, P0 100%, P1 >=95%), lean (>=60%, P0 100%)。
